title: Bërdicë residents protest Shkodër flooding and seek state attention
location: Entrance to Shkodër city; Bërdicë residents identified, exact assembly site unknown
organizer: Bërdicë residents and farmers; no named organization reported
participants_original: Euronews describes “some residents” and “some farmers”; no numerical attendance estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The report describes only “some” residents/farmers and supplies no assembled count. The approximately 350 hectares flooded is affected land, not attendance.

title.summary: Euronews and Balkanweb both describe a February 16 protest by flood-affected residents in Shkodër before Rama arrived; precise assembly group identity remains unverified.

start_date.summary: Euronews reports the protest that morning; Balkanweb dates its account to February 16, 2021 at 09:36 and says residents protested before Rama arrived.

end_date.summary: Neither opened account reports departure, dissolution or a physical end; date of publication is not used as an end.

location.summary: Euronews locates Bërdicë residents at Shkodër’s entrance; Balkanweb describes flood-affected Nënshkodër residents protesting in Shkodër. Neither gives a precise assembly site, and identity of the assembled group is not confirmed.

scope.summary: Both reports concern a local Shkodër protest before the Prime Minister’s visit; no wider coordination is established.

organizer.summary: Both describe residents; no named organizing body is identified.

demands.summary: Residents asked Prime Minister Rama and the government to attend to flooded homes and farmland, reporting that they had received no state assistance. The article does not specify a compensation demand.

participants_original.summary: Euronews says “some residents” and “some farmers”; Balkanweb says residents of flood-affected areas. Neither gives a number.

participants_min.summary: Unknown; neither source supplies a numerical lower bound.

participants_max.summary: Unknown; neither source supplies a numerical upper bound.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: At least 50 physically assembled people is not established. Both sources use qualitative wording without a count; the roughly 350 flooded hectares reported by Euronews describe land, not turnout.

protester_violence.summary: Neither account documents protester violence; silence does not establish its absence.

state_response.summary: Euronews reports no event-specific state response. Balkanweb notes nearby police and says protesters were scattered because gatherings were not allowed; it does not describe an event-specific order or physical clearing. All response dimensions remain unknown.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Neither account reports officials receiving or negotiating with this protest group.

state_response.beatings.summary: Neither account reports a state beating at this protest.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Balkanweb says protesters were scattered because gatherings were not allowed and police were nearby, but reports no event-specific order or attempt to clear them and no physical clearing. Code remains unknown.

state_response.ignore.summary: Residents’ report of prior lack of flood assistance does not establish explicit official refusal or avoidance in response to this protest.

state_response.killings.summary: Neither account reports a protest-related killing.

state_response.shootings.summary: Neither account reports a shooting at this protest.

notes: The source confirms a physical protest on February 16 directed at the Albanian government. Its reference to over a month of flooding describes the disaster, not protest duration. The 350-hectare figure is not a crowd estimate. Compensation is not stated in the opened Euronews article. A second contemporaneous Balkanweb report also describes residents from flood-affected Nënshkodër protesting before Rama arrived on February 16. It gives no attendance estimate and does not identify Bërdicë or a precise site; identity of the group and independent written origin remain unverified. Its mention of nearby police and scattered positioning under a gathering restriction is recorded separately from any inference about dispersal; all seven state-response values remain unknown.
open_questions: Find attributed attendance evidence to assess the 50-person threshold.
Determine whether the Balkanweb and Euronews reports describe the same assembled group and whether their written origins are independent.
Establish the precise gathering location and physical end; do not infer a one-day closure from article dates.
Verify whether an official actually received or responded to the demands.
